title: How to Fix Blurry Edges and Thickened Foil Lines

seo.title: How to Fix Blurry Edges and Thickened Foil Lines

content:
Blurry edges and thickened foil lines usually mean the hot stamping process is too strong for the artwork. Instead of missing foil, too much foil transfers around the intended design.

## Common Causes

The most common reasons are excessive temperature, too much machine force, long contact time or a foil grade that releases too easily for fine details. A dirty or worn stamping plate can also reduce edge clarity.

## How to Adjust

Do not change every setting at once. First reduce temperature slightly while keeping the other settings stable. If edges become cleaner, the original setting was too hot. If the problem remains, reduce machine force gradually and check the plate surface.

## Fine Text Needs a Different Standard

Small letters and thin lines need a cleaner transfer window than large solid areas. If your job contains both, test both before approving the foil.

## FAQ

### Why do small letters look thick after stamping?

The setting may be too strong or the foil may release too easily for fine detail.

### Should I change foil immediately?

Check process settings first. If the problem remains, test a clean-detail foil grade.

## Sample Support

Send your artwork and stamped sample photo. We can help judge whether the issue is process setting or foil grade.
